name: not-todo
author: Hyperion App Studio
description: Not ToDo — a list of things you should not do. Tap when you slip.

scripts.ios:sync: npm run build:prod && npx cap sync ios
scripts.android:sync: npm run build:prod && npx cap sync android
scripts.ios:open: npm run ios:sync && npx cap open ios
scripts.android:open: npm run android:sync && npx cap open android
scripts.ios:run: npm run build:dev && npx cap sync ios && npx cap run ios
scripts.android:run: npm run build:dev && npx cap sync android && npx cap run android
scripts.ios:live: npm run build:dev && npx cap run ios -l --port 4200
scripts.android:bundle: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew bundleRelease
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:sync && cd android && ./gradlew assembleRelease

scriptsHelp.start:lan: Serve on your LAN IP so a physical phone can hit the web server.
scriptsHelp.build:dev: Unoptimized development web build into www/.
scriptsHelp.build:prod: Optimized production web build into www/ (store packages).
scriptsHelp.ios:sync: Production build + sync into the Xcode project.
scriptsHelp.android:sync: Production build + sync into the Android Studio project.
scriptsHelp.ios:open: Production build, sync iOS, open Xcode (Archive → TestFlight / App Store).
scriptsHelp.android:open: Production build, sync Android, open Android Studio (signed bundle / Play).
scriptsHelp.ios:run: Dev build and run on the iOS Simulator or selected device.
scriptsHelp.android:run: Dev build and run on an Android emulator or device.
scriptsHelp.ios:live: Dev live-reload against the iOS Simulator. Never archive this.
scriptsHelp.android:live: Dev live-reload against an Android emulator. Never upload this.
scriptsHelp.ios:live:device: Live-reload on a physical iPhone (start:lan must already be running).
scriptsHelp.release:ios: Alias for ios:open — start of App Store / TestFlight flow.
scriptsHelp.release:android: Alias for android:open — start of Play Console flow.
scriptsHelp.android:apk: Production build + release APK for sideload testing.
